title: Courses
intro: I offer hands-on courses and workshops on handmade Pugliese pasta — orecchiette, cavatelli, strascinati, troccoli and other traditional forms — in private homes, at community events, and in cultural settings across London. Places are limited. Spigadolce is not just a cooking class; it is an act of love for a tradition I do not want to see disappear.
noUpcomingText: New course dates will be announced here soon. In the meantime, if you would like a private course for your group, event or celebration, I would love to hear from you.

events.title: Puglian Pasta Workshop
events.description: Join me at Altamura Bakehouse for a relaxed, hands-on evening of Puglian pasta-making. Together we will make traditional fresh pasta from scratch, using the simple gestures and techniques of Puglia — and then sit down to enjoy what you have made, with a choice of two homemade sauces.
includes: Dinner with the fresh pasta you have made
Choice of two homemade pasta sauces
events.note: No previous pasta-making experience needed — just come ready to cook, learn and enjoy the evening.
events.refundPolicy: Refunds up to 7 days before the event
events.homeSummary: A relaxed, hands-on evening of fresh Puglian pasta — welcome focaccia, a glass of prosecco and dinner with the pasta you make. £69.

events.title: A Taste of Puglia
events.venue: The Upper Place, 1st floor, Nag's Head Market
events.description: A day entirely dedicated to the flavours of Puglia. I will be giving live orecchiette-making demonstrations throughout the afternoon — come and try your hand at shaping the little ears of durum wheat that generations of Apulian women have made on wooden boards since time immemorial.
events.pastDescription: A day entirely dedicated to the flavours of Puglia. I gave live orecchiette-making demonstrations throughout the afternoon, and visitors tried their hand at shaping the little ears of durum wheat that generations of Apulian women have made on wooden boards since time immemorial.
events.ticketsNote: £3.96 entry (free for Pugliesi nel Mondo UK members)
events.homeSummary: Live orecchiette-making demonstrations at the Puglian Italian Fest, organised by Pugliesi nel Mondo UK

associationText: I am an active volunteer member of Pugliesi nel Mondo UK, a non-profit association dedicated to preserving and promoting the cultural heritage of Apulia within the United Kingdom. The association creates a bridge between Puglia and Britain — through cultural events, community gatherings, and the shared love of a region, its traditions, and its people.
inviteText: If you would like a Pugliese pasta course for your group, community event, cultural setting, school, library or private gathering, I would be delighted to hear from you. Each course can be tailored to the size and experience of your group.
